title: hix.round-trip/v1
description: Instruction payload carried inside a hix.projection/v1 manifest so a materialized capability can be observed back into its source-side instructions without re-parsing target-native files. Emitted by both the Codex-target and Claude-target materializers.

sourceCapabilityInstructions.description: Trimmed markdown body of the source SKILL.md.

sourceNativeAgentInstructions.description: Trimmed instructions of the source-native agent member. Omitted entirely when the source composition had no agent member, or when that member carried no instructions.
